knownIssues: Native-speaker translation review remains pending.

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: Use Preferences to choose the appearance, language and behavior of your application.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a preference group and adjust an available setting. Changes save automatically. Managed settings are enforced by your tenant administrator. Imports and resets cannot override a lock.

Administrators with preference-management permission can open Preference policies, choose default values and lock settings. Save policy applies the policy to this tenant and application. Unlocking restores saved personal choices.

tour.title: Layout
tour.text: Sidebar side, form style, result view, quick view and page size. Honoured by every module and page.

tour.title: Sidebar
tour.text: Placement, hover or click to open, pinning, and the rail's own palette — which can be a different theme from the page.

tour.title: Themes
tour.text: 14 themes; every component picks up tokens instantly. Each card is drawn with that theme's real colours.

tour.title: Typography
tour.text: Font family and three independent sizes — shell, forms and result tables — plus density and corner radius.

tour.title: Toasts
tour.text: Position, duration and style of notifications. Try one with the preview buttons.

tour.title: Language & help
tour.text: Language and direction, the help assistant, documentation and animations.

paragraphs: Use Preferences to choose the appearance, language and behavior of your application.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a preference group and adjust an available setting. Changes save automatically. Managed settings are enforced by your tenant administrator. Imports and resets cannot override a lock.

Administrators with preference-management permission can open Preference policies, choose default values and lock settings. Save policy applies the policy to this tenant and application. Unlocking restores saved personal choices.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.
Saves validate fields and identity duplicates, enforce record versions and reuse operation IDs for retries. Review the latest record explicitly after a conflict.
The shared shell supplies language, direction, theme, font, density, formatting and form navigation preferences. Preview controls do not change tenant policy.

Demo care data is fictional. Production clinical decisions, eligibility, file storage and notifications require authorized domain services. Unsaved values stay in memory; no sensitive drafts are silently persisted.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Use the section rail to scroll all nine patient sections. Tabs and wizard show one section at a time. The footer keeps New, Cancel, save and available care actions accessible while the form scrolls.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.
Saves validate fields and identity duplicates, enforce record versions and reuse operation IDs for retries. Review the latest record explicitly after a conflict.
The shared shell supplies language, direction, theme, font, density, formatting and form navigation preferences. Preview controls do not change tenant policy.

Demo care data is fictional. Production clinical decisions, eligibility, file storage and notifications require authorized domain services. Unsaved values stay in memory; no sensitive drafts are silently persisted.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Use the section rail to scroll all nine patient sections. Tabs and wizard show one section at a time. The footer keeps New, Cancel, save and available care actions accessible while the form scrolls.

MRN and registration fields are system-managed. Add names, contacts, documents and other repeated details as needed. Document upload stages file metadata only. Theme, layout and density controls use application preferences and cannot override administrator locks.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.
Saves validate fields and identity duplicates, enforce record versions and reuse operation IDs for retries. Review the latest record explicitly after a conflict.

Demo care data is fictional. Production clinical decisions, eligibility, file storage and notifications require authorized domain services. Unsaved values stay in memory; no sensitive drafts are silently persisted.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

Use the public typed workspace and adapters shown in TypeScript. The authenticated demo API reads patient CSV and writes a separate billing CSV ledger. Replace adapters to connect another application.
Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.

Input remains on screen during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load the latest ledger after a conflict and review your retained input. Browser-close draft restoration is not provided.

Fictional single-process demo: no real card processing, insurance submission, tax certification, pharmacy dispensing or accounting posting. Refunds reverse a full payment; invoices cannot be edited after issue.
Billing money keeps at least two decimal places so cents are not lost; general quantities retain your number preference.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

Use the public typed workspace and adapters shown in TypeScript. The authenticated demo API reads patient CSV and writes a separate billing CSV ledger. Replace adapters to connect another application.
Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.

Input remains on screen during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load the latest ledger after a conflict and review your retained input. Browser-close draft restoration is not provided.

Fictional single-process demo: no real card processing, insurance submission, tax certification, pharmacy dispensing or accounting posting. Refunds reverse a full payment; invoices cannot be edited after issue.
Billing money keeps at least two decimal places so cents are not lost; general quantities retain your number preference.

tour.text: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient. Enter the complaint, observed vital signs, allergy review, manual priority and next care area. Save a draft or review and complete. Previous assessments opens saved drafts and completed history. New assessment starts empty readings.

Use ClinicalTriageWorkspace with the typed triage and patient adapters shown in the TypeScript example. Authenticated API calls read patient CSV and persist assessments in a separate tenant/application/patient-scoped triage CSV.

The rail setting shows a compact three-column entry board. Tabs and wizard show one group at a time. Theme, fonts, density, radius, language and history-table preferences follow tenant locks. Ctrl/Cmd+S saves a draft only when shortcuts are enabled and focus is inside this form.

Drafts are explicitly saved to the API and resume when reopening the patient. Unsaved input remains during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load latest after a conflict; a completed server record replaces stale edits and must be reassessed separately.

This is a fictional entry workflow, not a validated triage scale, clinical score or treatment recommendation. Priority is always assigned manually. Production protocols, clinical review, dedicated nurse permissions and retention controls belong to the integrating application.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.
Saves validate fields and identity duplicates, enforce record versions and reuse operation IDs for retries. Review the latest record explicitly after a conflict.
The shared shell supplies language, direction, theme, font, density, formatting and form navigation preferences. Preview controls do not change tenant policy.

Demo care data is fictional. Production clinical decisions, eligibility, file storage and notifications require authorized domain services. Unsaved values stay in memory; no sensitive drafts are silently persisted.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Use the section rail to scroll all nine patient sections. Tabs and wizard show one section at a time. The footer keeps New, Cancel, save and available care actions accessible while the form scrolls.

MRN and registration fields are system-managed. Add names, contacts, documents and other repeated details as needed. Document upload stages file metadata only. Theme, layout and density controls use application preferences and cannot override administrator locks.

Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient. Enter the complaint, observed vital signs, allergy review, manual priority and next care area. Save a draft or review and complete. Previous assessments opens saved drafts and completed history. New assessment starts empty readings.

Use ClinicalTriageWorkspace with the typed triage and patient adapters shown in the TypeScript example. Authenticated API calls read patient CSV and persist assessments in a separate tenant/application/patient-scoped triage CSV.

The rail setting shows a compact three-column entry board. Tabs and wizard show one group at a time. Theme, fonts, density, radius, language and history-table preferences follow tenant locks. Ctrl/Cmd+S saves a draft only when shortcuts are enabled and focus is inside this form.

Drafts are explicitly saved to the API and resume when reopening the patient. Unsaved input remains during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load latest after a conflict; a completed server record replaces stale edits and must be reassessed separately.

This is a fictional entry workflow, not a validated triage scale, clinical score or treatment recommendation. Priority is always assigned manually. Production protocols, clinical review, dedicated nurse permissions and retention controls belong to the integrating application.

releases.title: Clinical Consultation
releases.summary: Twelve sections are available through one-click tabs inside three columns: visit, background, vitals, allergies, assessment, systems, results, procedures, plan, medicines, referrals and education. Tab counts show entered fields. Values stay when switching sections. New optional fields save through the demo API; older notes remain readable. Vitals are manually entered, and prescriptions, procedures, referrals and consent remain documentation notes rather than dispatched or signed actions.
knownIssues: Most page guides are schema-based references awaiting detailed workflow authoring.
Native-speaker and healthcare-domain review remain pending.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.
Saves validate fields and identity duplicates, enforce record versions and reuse operation IDs for retries. Review the latest record explicitly after a conflict.
The shared shell supplies language, direction, theme, font, density, formatting and form navigation preferences. Preview controls do not change tenant policy.

Demo care data is fictional. Production clinical decisions, eligibility, file storage and notifications require authorized domain services. Unsaved values stay in memory; no sensitive drafts are silently persisted.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Use the section rail to scroll all nine patient sections. Tabs and wizard show one section at a time. The footer keeps New, Cancel, save and available care actions accessible while the form scrolls.

MRN and registration fields are system-managed. Add names, contacts, documents and other repeated details as needed. Document upload stages file metadata only. Theme, layout and density controls use application preferences and cannot override administrator locks.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

Use the public typed workspace and adapters shown in TypeScript. The authenticated demo API reads patient CSV and writes a separate billing CSV ledger. Replace adapters to connect another application.
Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.

Input remains on screen during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load the latest ledger after a conflict and review your retained input. Browser-close draft restoration is not provided.

Fictional single-process demo: no real card processing, insurance submission, tax certification, pharmacy dispensing or accounting posting. Refunds reverse a full payment; invoices cannot be edited after issue.
Billing money keeps at least two decimal places so cents are not lost; general quantities retain your number preference.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient. Enter the complaint, observed vital signs, allergy review, manual priority and next care area. Save a draft or review and complete. Previous assessments opens saved drafts and completed history. New assessment starts empty readings.

Use ClinicalTriageWorkspace with the typed triage and patient adapters shown in the TypeScript example. Authenticated API calls read patient CSV and persist assessments in a separate tenant/application/patient-scoped triage CSV.

The rail setting shows a compact three-column entry board. Tabs and wizard show one group at a time. Theme, fonts, density, radius, language and history-table preferences follow tenant locks. Ctrl/Cmd+S saves a draft only when shortcuts are enabled and focus is inside this form.

Drafts are explicitly saved to the API and resume when reopening the patient. Unsaved input remains during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load latest after a conflict; a completed server record replaces stale edits and must be reassessed separately.

This is a fictional entry workflow, not a validated triage scale, clinical score or treatment recommendation. Priority is always assigned manually. Production protocols, clinical review, dedicated nurse permissions and retention controls belong to the integrating application.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient and encounter, choose the clinician and visit type, then enter history, examination, assessment and plan. Save a draft or review and complete. Open previous consultations to resume drafts or view completed notes.

Twelve sections are available through one-click tabs inside three columns: visit, background, vitals, allergies, assessment, systems, results, procedures, plan, medicines, referrals and education. Tab counts show entered fields. Values stay when switching sections. New optional fields save through the demo API; older notes remain readable. Vitals are manually entered, and prescriptions, procedures, referrals and consent remain documentation notes rather than dispatched or signed actions.

Use ClinicalConsultationWorkspace with the typed consultation and patient adapters. Authenticated calls read patient CSV and persist notes in a separate tenant/application/patient-scoped consultation CSV.
Rail shows all three groups side by side. Tabs and wizard show one group at a time. Theme, fonts, radius, language, shortcuts and history tables follow effective tenant preferences.

Saved API drafts resume when reopening the patient. Recoverable errors retain mounted input and retry identity. Reload a stale revision before reviewing and saving again. Completed notes stay read-only.

Fictional documentation workflow. No diagnosis suggestions, prescribing, investigation dispatch, appointment booking, billing, electronic signature or clinical decision support is performed. Clinical review and production EHR integration remain application responsibilities.

releases.title: OP Consultation
releases.summary: OP Consultation shares saved notes with Clinical Consultation. Use the section navigator, edit in the focused form, and follow the live documentation summary. Summary field buttons jump to the related section. Review full note displays all recorded sections without saving. The patient banner reads the latest completed triage from the demo API as reference only; open its details to review all measurements. Triage belongs to its original encounter and is not copied automatically.

sections.title: How to use this page

After saving, return to the worklist and verify the customer appears with the expected details. If another session changed the record, reload and compare before resubmitting.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.
Saves validate fields and identity duplicates, enforce record versions and reuse operation IDs for retries. Review the latest record explicitly after a conflict.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

Use the public typed workspace and adapters shown in TypeScript. The authenticated demo API reads patient CSV and writes a separate billing CSV ledger. Replace adapters to connect another application.
Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.

Input remains on screen during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load the latest ledger after a conflict and review your retained input. Browser-close draft restoration is not provided.

Fictional single-process demo: no real card processing, insurance submission, tax certification, pharmacy dispensing or accounting posting. Refunds reverse a full payment; invoices cannot be edited after issue.
Billing money keeps at least two decimal places so cents are not lost; general quantities retain your number preference.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient. Enter the complaint, observed vital signs, allergy review, manual priority and next care area. Save a draft or review and complete. Previous assessments opens saved drafts and completed history. New assessment starts empty readings.

Use ClinicalTriageWorkspace with the typed triage and patient adapters shown in the TypeScript example. Authenticated API calls read patient CSV and persist assessments in a separate tenant/application/patient-scoped triage CSV.

The rail setting shows a compact three-column entry board. Tabs and wizard show one group at a time. Theme, fonts, density, radius, language and history-table preferences follow tenant locks. Ctrl/Cmd+S saves a draft only when shortcuts are enabled and focus is inside this form.

Drafts are explicitly saved to the API and resume when reopening the patient. Unsaved input remains during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load latest after a conflict; a completed server record replaces stale edits and must be reassessed separately.

This is a fictional entry workflow, not a validated triage scale, clinical score or treatment recommendation. Priority is always assigned manually. Production protocols, clinical review, dedicated nurse permissions and retention controls belong to the integrating application.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient and encounter, choose the clinician and visit type, then enter history, examination, assessment and plan. Save a draft or review and complete. Open previous consultations to resume drafts or view completed notes.

Twelve sections are available through one-click tabs inside three columns: visit, background, vitals, allergies, assessment, systems, results, procedures, plan, medicines, referrals and education. Tab counts show entered fields. Values stay when switching sections. New optional fields save through the demo API; older notes remain readable. Vitals are manually entered, and prescriptions, procedures, referrals and consent remain documentation notes rather than dispatched or signed actions.

Rail shows all three groups side by side. Tabs and wizard show one group at a time. Theme, fonts, radius, language, shortcuts and history tables follow effective tenant preferences.

Saved API drafts resume when reopening the patient. Recoverable errors retain mounted input and retry identity. Reload a stale revision before reviewing and saving again. Completed notes stay read-only.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.
Saves validate fields and identity duplicates, enforce record versions and reuse operation IDs for retries. Review the latest record explicitly after a conflict.
The shared shell supplies language, direction, theme, font, density, formatting and form navigation preferences. Preview controls do not change tenant policy.

Demo care data is fictional. Production clinical decisions, eligibility, file storage and notifications require authorized domain services. Unsaved values stay in memory; no sensitive drafts are silently persisted.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Use the section rail to scroll all nine patient sections. Tabs and wizard show one section at a time. The footer keeps New, Cancel, save and available care actions accessible while the form scrolls.

MRN and registration fields are system-managed. Add names, contacts, documents and other repeated details as needed. Document upload stages file metadata only. Theme, layout and density controls use application preferences and cannot override administrator locks.

paragraphs: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

Use the public typed workspace and adapters shown in TypeScript. The authenticated demo API reads patient CSV and writes a separate billing CSV ledger. Replace adapters to connect another application.
Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient. Enter the complaint, observed vital signs, allergy review, manual priority and next care area. Save a draft or review and complete. Previous assessments opens saved drafts and completed history. New assessment starts empty readings.

Use ClinicalTriageWorkspace with the typed triage and patient adapters shown in the TypeScript example. Authenticated API calls read patient CSV and persist assessments in a separate tenant/application/patient-scoped triage CSV.

The rail setting shows a compact three-column entry board. Tabs and wizard show one group at a time. Theme, fonts, density, radius, language and history-table preferences follow tenant locks. Ctrl/Cmd+S saves a draft only when shortcuts are enabled and focus is inside this form.

Drafts are explicitly saved to the API and resume when reopening the patient. Unsaved input remains during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load latest after a conflict; a completed server record replaces stale edits and must be reassessed separately.

This is a fictional entry workflow, not a validated triage scale, clinical score or treatment recommendation. Priority is always assigned manually. Production protocols, clinical review, dedicated nurse permissions and retention controls belong to the integrating application.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient and encounter, choose the clinician and visit type, then enter history, examination, assessment and plan. Save a draft or review and complete. Open previous consultations to resume drafts or view completed notes.

Twelve sections are available through one-click tabs inside three columns: visit, background, vitals, allergies, assessment, systems, results, procedures, plan, medicines, referrals and education. Vitals are manually entered, and prescriptions, procedures, referrals and consent remain documentation notes rather than dispatched or signed actions.

Saved API drafts resume when reopening the patient. Recoverable errors retain mounted input and retry identity. Reload a stale revision before reviewing and saving again. Completed notes stay read-only.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

Use the public typed workspace and adapters shown in TypeScript. The authenticated demo API reads patient CSV and writes a separate billing CSV ledger. Replace adapters to connect another application.
Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.

Input remains on screen during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load the latest ledger after a conflict and review your retained input. Browser-close draft restoration is not provided.

Fictional single-process demo: no real card processing, insurance submission, tax certification, pharmacy dispensing or accounting posting. Refunds reverse a full payment; invoices cannot be edited after issue.
Billing money keeps at least two decimal places so cents are not lost; general quantities retain your number preference.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient. Enter the complaint, observed vital signs, allergy review, manual priority and next care area. Save a draft or review and complete. Previous assessments opens saved drafts and completed history. New assessment starts empty readings.

Use ClinicalTriageWorkspace with the typed triage and patient adapters shown in the TypeScript example. Authenticated API calls read patient CSV and persist assessments in a separate tenant/application/patient-scoped triage CSV.

The rail setting shows a compact three-column entry board. Tabs and wizard show one group at a time. Theme, fonts, density, radius, language and history-table preferences follow tenant locks. Ctrl/Cmd+S saves a draft only when shortcuts are enabled and focus is inside this form.

Drafts are explicitly saved to the API and resume when reopening the patient. Unsaved input remains during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load latest after a conflict; a completed server record replaces stale edits and must be reassessed separately.

This is a fictional entry workflow, not a validated triage scale, clinical score or treatment recommendation. Priority is always assigned manually. Production protocols, clinical review, dedicated nurse permissions and retention controls belong to the integrating application.

tour.title: Clinical Triage

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient and encounter, choose the clinician and visit type, then enter history, examination, assessment and plan. Save a draft or review and complete. Open previous consultations to resume drafts or view completed notes.

Twelve sections are available through one-click tabs inside three columns: visit, background, vitals, allergies, assessment, systems, results, procedures, plan, medicines, referrals and education. Tab counts show entered fields. Values stay when switching sections. New optional fields save through the demo API; older notes remain readable. Vitals are manually entered, and prescriptions, procedures, referrals and consent remain documentation notes rather than dispatched or signed actions.

Use ClinicalConsultationWorkspace with the typed consultation and patient adapters. Authenticated calls read patient CSV and persist notes in a separate tenant/application/patient-scoped consultation CSV.
Rail shows all three groups side by side. Tabs and wizard show one group at a time. Theme, fonts, radius, language, shortcuts and history tables follow effective tenant preferences.

Saved API drafts resume when reopening the patient. Recoverable errors retain mounted input and retry identity. Reload a stale revision before reviewing and saving again. Completed notes stay read-only.

Fictional documentation workflow. No diagnosis suggestions, prescribing, investigation dispatch, appointment booking, billing, electronic signature or clinical decision support is performed. Clinical review and production EHR integration remain application responsibilities.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

sections.title: Billing corrections and shared clinical rail
paragraphs: Open Invoices & payments, then View bill for the full invoice, insurance, line totals, receipts and revision history. Edit bill changes quantities, discount, insurance authorization and notes on unpaid issued invoices. Enter a correction reason and confirm. The API recalculates using its current tariffs and retains the previous invoice snapshot. Payment history, including refunds, prevents edits. Conflicts require loading and reviewing the latest ledger before saving again. Unsaved correction values survive recoverable failures; Back to billing confirms discard.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

Use the public typed workspace and adapters shown in TypeScript. The authenticated demo API reads patient CSV and writes a separate billing CSV ledger. Replace adapters to connect another application.
Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.

Input remains on screen during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load the latest ledger after a conflict and review your retained input. Browser-close draft restoration is not provided.

Fictional single-process demo: no real card processing, insurance submission, tax certification, pharmacy dispensing or accounting posting. Refunds reverse a full payment; invoices cannot be edited after issue.
Billing money keeps at least two decimal places so cents are not lost; general quantities retain your number preference.

tour.title: Billing Clinic
tour.text: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

sections.title: Billing corrections and shared clinical rail
paragraphs: Use the numbered master-record rail to move between Complaint & safety, Vital signs and Disposition & handoff. One section is visible at a time beside the triage snapshot. Save draft and Complete triage stay in the action bar. Tabs and wizard remain available through effective preferences. Values, choices, history and saves use the demo API; the summary reflects entered data and is not a clinical recommendation.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient. Enter the complaint, observed vital signs, allergy review, manual priority and next care area. Save a draft or review and complete. Previous assessments opens saved drafts and completed history. New assessment starts empty readings.

Use ClinicalTriageWorkspace with the typed triage and patient adapters shown in the TypeScript example. Authenticated API calls read patient CSV and persist assessments in a separate tenant/application/patient-scoped triage CSV.

Values, choices, history and saves use the demo API; the summary reflects entered data and is not a clinical recommendation.

Drafts are explicitly saved to the API and resume when reopening the patient. Unsaved input remains during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load latest after a conflict; a completed server record replaces stale edits and must be reassessed separately.

This is a fictional entry workflow, not a validated triage scale, clinical score or treatment recommendation. Priority is always assigned manually. Production protocols, clinical review, dedicated nurse permissions and retention controls belong to the integrating application.

tour.title: Clinical Triage
tour.text: Select a patient. Enter the complaint, observed vital signs, allergy review, manual priority and next care area. Save a draft or review and complete. Previous assessments opens saved drafts and completed history. New assessment starts empty readings.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient and encounter, choose the clinician and visit type, then enter history, examination, assessment and plan. Save a draft or review and complete. Open previous consultations to resume drafts or view completed notes.

Twelve sections are available through one-click tabs inside three columns: visit, background, vitals, allergies, assessment, systems, results, procedures, plan, medicines, referrals and education. Tab counts show entered fields. Values stay when switching sections. New optional fields save through the demo API; older notes remain readable. Vitals are manually entered, and prescriptions, procedures, referrals and consent remain documentation notes rather than dispatched or signed actions.

Use ClinicalConsultationWorkspace with the typed consultation and patient adapters. Authenticated calls read patient CSV and persist notes in a separate tenant/application/patient-scoped consultation CSV.
Rail shows all three groups side by side. Tabs and wizard show one group at a time. Theme, fonts, radius, language, shortcuts and history tables follow effective tenant preferences.

Saved API drafts resume when reopening the patient. Recoverable errors retain mounted input and retry identity. Reload a stale revision before reviewing and saving again. Completed notes stay read-only.

Fictional documentation workflow. No diagnosis suggestions, prescribing, investigation dispatch, appointment booking, billing, electronic signature or clinical decision support is performed. Clinical review and production EHR integration remain application responsibilities.

tour.title: Clinical Consultation
tour.text: Select a patient and encounter, choose the clinician and visit type, then enter history, examination, assessment and plan. Save a draft or review and complete. Open previous consultations to resume drafts or view completed notes.

Triage belongs to its original encounter and is not copied automatically.

paragraphs: The numbered master-record rail replaces the separate consultation navigator. Select one section to work beside the consultation snapshot; the scroll area stays within the record layout. Tabs and wizard follow effective preferences and tenant locks. Existing API document, order, score, review and signing flows remain in place.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Choose a patient and encounter, document the consultation, add linked diagnoses and orders, review the full record, then attest and sign the demo record.
Switching specialty preserves entered fields; all entered specialty notes appear in review.
Orders are saved with this record. No pharmacy, laboratory or billing submission is connected.

Use ComprehensiveConsultationWorkspace with authenticated patient, triage and comprehensive consultation adapters. Configuration and service catalogs come from the demo API; records persist in a separate CSV.
The host controls theme, language, formatting, spacing and form navigation. Tenant locks apply; changing sections preserves entered values.

Finalize this demo record under your authenticated account. It becomes read-only. This does not transmit orders or create a certified digital signature. Demo completeness checks only. External validation and reporting require approved, versioned integrations.

sections.title: Billing corrections and shared clinical rail
paragraphs: View and correct unpaid bills through the API. Triage and comprehensive consultation share the master-record rail with a focused section and summary.

releases.title: Page Library catalog
releases.summary: Open Page Library → List of pages to browse the pages available to your account. Search by name, then open a working page or read its TypeScript example, demo description and user/integration guide. The catalog follows the authenticated navigation API; it does not grant access to hidden pages.
knownIssues: Most page guides are schema-based references awaiting detailed workflow authoring.
Native-speaker and healthcare-domain review remain pending.

sections.title: Billing corrections and shared clinical rail
paragraphs: Open Invoices & payments, then View bill for the full invoice, insurance, line totals, receipts and revision history. sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.
Saves validate fields and identity duplicates, enforce record versions and reuse operation IDs for retries. Review the latest record explicitly after a conflict.

sections.title: Billing corrections and shared clinical rail
paragraphs: Open Invoices & payments, then View bill for the full invoice, insurance, line totals, receipts and revision history. Edit bill changes quantities, discount, insurance authorization and notes on unpaid issued invoices. Enter a correction reason and confirm. The API recalculates using its current tariffs and retains the previous invoice snapshot. Payment history, including refunds, prevents edits. Conflicts require loading and reviewing the latest ledger before saving again. Unsaved correction values survive recoverable failures; Back to billing confirms discard.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

Use the public typed workspace and adapters shown in TypeScript. The authenticated demo API reads patient CSV and writes a separate billing CSV ledger. Replace adapters to connect another application.
Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.

Input remains on screen during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load the latest ledger after a conflict and review your retained input. Browser-close draft restoration is not provided.

Fictional single-process demo: no real card processing, insurance submission, tax certification, pharmacy dispensing or accounting posting. Refunds reverse a full payment; invoices cannot be edited after issue.
Billing money keeps at least two decimal places so cents are not lost; general quantities retain your number preference.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient and encounter, choose the clinician and visit type, then enter history, examination, assessment and plan. Save a draft or review and complete. Open previous consultations to resume drafts or view completed notes.

Twelve sections are available through one-click tabs inside three columns: visit, background, vitals, allergies, assessment, systems, results, procedures, plan, medicines, referrals and education. Tab counts show entered fields. Values stay when switching sections. New optional fields save through the demo API; older notes remain readable. Vitals are manually entered, and prescriptions, procedures, referrals and consent remain documentation notes rather than dispatched or signed actions.

Use ClinicalConsultationWorkspace with the typed consultation and patient adapters. Authenticated calls read patient CSV and persist notes in a separate tenant/application/patient-scoped consultation CSV.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.
Saves validate fields and identity duplicates, enforce record versions and reuse operation IDs for retries. Review the latest record explicitly after a conflict.

paragraphs: Open Invoices & payments, then View bill for the full invoice, insurance, line totals, receipts and revision history. sections.title: Validation and recovery
paragraphs: The server rejects missing identity and consent, duplicate active visits, stale record versions, invalid vital signs and payments above the balance. Signed notes use addenda. Pending results require an owner, due date and plan before checkout. Network retries reuse the operation ID. Saved drafts require identity and consent review again; tenant storage, retention and field exclusions apply. Reloading a conflicting record replaces the local form, so compare your values first.

sections.title: Access and preferences
paragraphs: Navigation access and write permission are checked by the demo API. The demo administrator can write; other authorized users can read. Effective theme, font scales, density, table settings, number/date/time formatting and language are inherited, including tenant locks. Currency comes from the ledger; formatting does not convert amounts. The five-step workflow and care tabs are fixed by this template, rather than the generic record navigation preference.

sections.title: Integration
paragraphs: Compose RegistrationWorkspace with a RegistrationAdapter, ClinicalTemplateAdapter, authenticated scopeKey and PreferenceHost. The POST /op-registration endpoint loads configuration and executes versioned commands. Providers and services are read from CSV; encounters, appointments, payments and retry receipts share an atomic CSV snapshot scoped by tenant and application. Patient demographics reuse the existing patient API. These encounter records are separate from the older consultation and billing template stores. No real payer, payment, messaging or electronic-signature integration is connected.

paragraphs: Select a preference group and adjust an available setting. Changes save automatically. Managed settings are enforced by your tenant administrator. Imports and resets cannot override a lock.

Administrators with preference-management permission can open Preference policies, choose default values and lock settings. Save policy applies the policy to this tenant and application. Unlocking restores saved personal choices.

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: Search, review and manage saved views records with saved views and configurable actions.
Reusable schema-driven record form.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Start typing to search every visible column. How it matches — smart, contains or starts-with — is a preference.
Basic filters are always visible. Open Advanced filters for dates and less common fields.
Switch between a dense table and a card grid. Your choice is saved to your account.
Show or hide columns per worklist. Click a header to sort. Saved per browser or per account, your choice.
New opens a blank form — in a new tab or in place, per your preference.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
paragraphs: Use the field reference below to check required values. If an action is unavailable, check your role and the current record state. Reload after a conflict and review the latest record before saving again.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Page Help, catalog guides and Documentation Center show the same API article for the page and selected language. Source changes can mark translations outdated; review status is separate from translation availability.

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: Read page guides, published releases, patches and change notices for this application.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Choose a guide or a release. Search by title, module or guide content. Select a release to read the guide snapshot for that version. Open What’s new to find changes affecting pages you can access.

Read explanation opens the linked section and records the notice as read. I understand is a separate acknowledgment and appears only when required. Reference guides and unreviewed translations are clearly labeled.

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: Sanitized application diagnostics collected by Sentinel.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Filter incidents by page and status. Open an incident to inspect sanitized diagnostics. Move it to Investigating or Resolved. A recurring failure reopens a resolved incident.

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: Find and resume your unfinished work.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Opening never submits a record or approval. Reselect CSV files to restore mappings. Refresh if another window changed a draft. Each application has its own recovery center.
Draft storage is enabled by your tenant policy. Only service-acknowledged changes are recoverable.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.
Saves validate fields and identity duplicates, enforce record versions and reuse operation IDs for retries. Review the latest record explicitly after a conflict.
The shared shell supplies language, direction, theme, font, density, formatting and form navigation preferences. Preview controls do not change tenant policy.

Demo care data is fictional. Production clinical decisions, eligibility, file storage and notifications require authorized domain services. Unsaved values stay in memory; no sensitive drafts are silently persisted.

paragraphs: Select a patient in the Billing Clinic card on List of pages. Billing opens in a patient-specific tab and retrieves the ledger from the API. The rail keeps navigation at the top and shows one active section. Introductory statistics and the workflow banner are removed; order, invoice and payment actions remain in their sections.

sections.title: Billing corrections and shared clinical rail
paragraphs: Open Invoices & payments, then View bill for the full invoice, insurance, line totals, receipts and revision history. Edit bill changes quantities, discount, insurance authorization and notes on unpaid issued invoices. Enter a correction reason and confirm. The API recalculates using its current tariffs and retains the previous invoice snapshot. Payment history, including refunds, prevents edits. Conflicts require loading and reviewing the latest ledger before saving again. Unsaved correction values survive recoverable failures; Back to billing confirms discard.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

Use the public typed workspace and adapters shown in TypeScript. The authenticated demo API reads patient CSV and writes a separate billing CSV ledger. Replace adapters to connect another application.
Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.

Input remains on screen during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load the latest ledger after a conflict and review your retained input. Browser-close draft restoration is not provided.

Fictional single-process demo: no real card processing, insurance submission, tax certification, pharmacy dispensing or accounting posting. Refunds reverse a full payment; invoices cannot be edited after issue.
Billing money keeps at least two decimal places so cents are not lost; general quantities retain your number preference.

paragraphs: Select a patient. Enter the complaint, observed vital signs, allergy review, manual priority and next care area. Save a draft or review and complete. Previous assessments opens saved drafts and completed history. New assessment starts empty readings.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient and encounter, choose the clinician and visit type, then enter history, examination, assessment and plan. Save a draft or review and complete. Open previous consultations to resume drafts or view completed notes.

Twelve sections are available through one-click tabs inside three columns: visit, background, vitals, allergies, assessment, systems, results, procedures, plan, medicines, referrals and education. Tab counts show entered fields. Values stay when switching sections. New optional fields save through the demo API; older notes remain readable. Vitals are manually entered, and prescriptions, procedures, referrals and consent remain documentation notes rather than dispatched or signed actions.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Search for a patient or create one using New patient. Confirm name and date of birth, review visit details, coverage and consent, then register and check in. Use the Nursing, Consultation, Orders, Billing and Checkout tabs without leaving this page. Sign the note before consultation charges post. Complete services before their charges post. Use the worklist to reopen a saved encounter.

sections.title: Validation and recovery
paragraphs: The server rejects missing identity and consent, duplicate active visits, stale record versions, invalid vital signs and payments above the balance. Signed notes use addenda. Pending results require an owner, due date and plan before checkout. Network retries reuse the operation ID. Saved drafts require identity and consent review again; tenant storage, retention and field exclusions apply. Reloading a conflicting record replaces the local form, so compare your values first.

sections.title: Access and preferences
paragraphs: Navigation access and write permission are checked by the demo API. The demo administrator can write; other authorized users can read. Effective theme, font scales, density, table settings, number/date/time formatting and language are inherited, including tenant locks. Currency comes from the ledger; formatting does not convert amounts. The five-step workflow and care tabs are fixed by this template, rather than the generic record navigation preference.

sections.title: Integration
paragraphs: Compose RegistrationWorkspace with a RegistrationAdapter, ClinicalTemplateAdapter, authenticated scopeKey and PreferenceHost. The POST /op-registration endpoint loads configuration and executes versioned commands. Providers and services are read from CSV; encounters, appointments, payments and retry receipts share an atomic CSV snapshot scoped by tenant and application. Patient demographics reuse the existing patient API. These encounter records are separate from the older consultation and billing template stores. No real payer, payment, messaging or electronic-signature integration is connected.

paragraphs: This library previews backend-generated barcode and QR labels. Use dedicated pages for items, specimens, patient bands, documents, payment demos, batch printing and printer profiles.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Choose a template, paper profile, records and copies. Generate a preview, verify the identifying information, then open Print preview. Use actual size and disable browser headers. Save as PDF through the browser print dialog. Printing records a request, not confirmed physical delivery.

sections.title: Validation and recovery
paragraphs: The API rejects invalid records, excessive copies and labels that do not fit the paper. Reprints require permission and a reason. Retry preserves the operation identity. Payment links are synthetic; only an administrator can simulate payment status, and expired requests cannot be printed.

sections.title: Access and preferences
paragraphs: The server isolates jobs by tenant, application and user. Tenant administrators control copy limits, reprints and locked printer profiles. Users can save an unlocked default profile. Screen preferences and language apply to the interface; printed codes retain approved dimensions and black-on-white contrast.

sections.title: Integration
paragraphs: Inject LabelAdapter and effective preferences into LabelPrintingWorkspace. The authenticated POST /label-printing API owns record lookup, code generation and job history. Templates use JSON; synthetic records and scoped jobs use CSV. Replace the adapter for real applications. Payment providers, direct thermal printing and physical scanner certification remain external integrations.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a preference group and adjust an available setting. Changes save automatically. Managed settings are enforced by your tenant administrator. Imports and resets cannot override a lock.

Administrators with preference-management permission can open Preference policies, choose default values and lock settings. Save policy applies the policy to this tenant and application. Unlocking restores saved personal choices.

tour.text: Basic filters are always visible. Open Advanced filters for dates and less common fields.

tour.title: Choose a view
tour.text: Switch between a dense table and a card grid. Your choice is saved to your account.

tour.title: Pick your columns
tour.text: Show or hide columns per worklist. Click a header to sort. Saved per browser or per account, your choice.

tour.title: Create a record

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: Read page guides, published releases, patches and change notices for this application.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Choose a guide or a release. Search by title, module or guide content. Select a release to read the guide snapshot for that version. Open What’s new to find changes affecting pages you can access.

Read explanation opens the linked section and records the notice as read. I understand is a separate acknowledgment and appears only when required. Reference guides and unreviewed translations are clearly labeled.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.

sections.title: Billing corrections and shared clinical rail
paragraphs: Open Invoices & payments, then View bill for the full invoice, insurance, line totals, receipts and revision history. Edit bill changes quantities, discount, insurance authorization and notes on unpaid issued invoices. Enter a correction reason and confirm. The API recalculates using its current tariffs and retains the previous invoice snapshot. Payment history, including refunds, prevents edits. Conflicts require loading and reviewing the latest ledger before saving again. Unsaved correction values survive recoverable failures; Back to billing confirms discard.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

Use the public typed workspace and adapters shown in TypeScript. The authenticated demo API reads patient CSV and writes a separate billing CSV ledger. Replace adapters to connect another application.
Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.

Input remains on screen during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load the latest ledger after a conflict and review your retained input. Browser-close draft restoration is not provided.

Fictional single-process demo: no real card processing, insurance submission, tax certification, pharmacy dispensing or accounting posting. Refunds reverse a full payment; invoices cannot be edited after issue.
Billing money keeps at least two decimal places so cents are not lost; general quantities retain your number preference.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Search for a patient or create one using New patient. Confirm name and date of birth, review visit details, coverage and consent, then register and check in. sections.title: Validation and recovery
paragraphs: The server rejects missing identity and consent, duplicate active visits, stale record versions, invalid vital signs and payments above the balance. Signed notes use addenda. Pending results require an owner, due date and plan before checkout. Network retries reuse the operation ID. Saved drafts require identity and consent review again; tenant storage, retention and field exclusions apply. Reloading a conflicting record replaces the local form, so compare your values first.

sections.title: Access and preferences
paragraphs: Navigation access and write permission are checked by the demo API. The demo administrator can write; other authorized users can read. Effective theme, font scales, density, table settings, number/date/time formatting and language are inherited, including tenant locks. Currency comes from the ledger; formatting does not convert amounts. The five-step workflow and care tabs are fixed by this template, rather than the generic record navigation preference.

sections.title: Integration
paragraphs: Compose RegistrationWorkspace with a RegistrationAdapter, ClinicalTemplateAdapter, authenticated scopeKey and PreferenceHost. The POST /op-registration endpoint loads configuration and executes versioned commands. Providers and services are read from CSV; encounters, appointments, payments and retry receipts share an atomic CSV snapshot scoped by tenant and application. Patient demographics reuse the existing patient API. These encounter records are separate from the older consultation and billing template stores. No real payer, payment, messaging or electronic-signature integration is connected.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: This library previews backend-generated barcode and QR labels. Use dedicated pages for items, specimens, patient bands, documents, payment demos, batch printing and printer profiles.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Choose a template, paper profile, records and copies. Generate a preview, verify the identifying information, then open Print preview. Use actual size and disable browser headers. Save as PDF through the browser print dialog. Printing records a request, not confirmed physical delivery.

sections.title: Validation and recovery
paragraphs: The API rejects invalid records, excessive copies and labels that do not fit the paper. Reprints require permission and a reason. Retry preserves the operation identity. Payment links are synthetic; only an administrator can simulate payment status, and expired requests cannot be printed.

Your default stock does not fit this label. A compatible profile is selected for this preview; your saved default is unchanged. The tenant-locked printer stock does not fit this label. Ask your administrator to unlock it or select compatible stock.

sections.title: Access and preferences
paragraphs: The server isolates jobs by tenant, application and user. Tenant administrators control copy limits, reprints and locked printer profiles. Users can save an unlocked default profile. Screen preferences and language apply to the interface; printed codes retain approved dimensions and black-on-white contrast.

sections.title: Integration
paragraphs: Inject LabelAdapter and effective preferences into LabelPrintingWorkspace. The authenticated POST /label-printing API owns record lookup, code generation and job history. Templates use JSON; synthetic records and scoped jobs use CSV. Replace the adapter for real applications. Payment providers, direct thermal printing and physical scanner certification remain external integrations.

sections.title: Billing corrections and shared clinical rail
paragraphs: Open Invoices & payments, then View bill for the full invoice, insurance, line totals, receipts and revision history. Edit bill changes quantities, discount, insurance authorization and notes on unpaid issued invoices. Enter a correction reason and confirm. Conflicts require loading and reviewing the latest ledger before saving again. Unsaved correction values survive recoverable failures; Back to billing confirms discard.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: OP Registration keeps patient selection, registration, care and checkout in one page. Its five-step progress bar, patient strip, contextual side panels and bottom actions stay inside the existing application shell. All patient and encounter data comes from the authenticated demo API.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Search for a patient or create one using New patient. Confirm name and date of birth, review visit details, coverage and consent, then register and check in. Use the Nursing, Consultation, Orders, Billing and Checkout tabs without leaving this page. Sign the note before consultation charges post. Complete services before their charges post. Use the worklist to reopen a saved encounter.

sections.title: Validation and recovery
paragraphs: The server rejects missing identity and consent, duplicate active visits, stale record versions, invalid vital signs and payments above the balance. Signed notes use addenda. Pending results require an owner, due date and plan before checkout. Network retries reuse the operation ID. Saved drafts require identity and consent review again; tenant storage, retention and field exclusions apply. Reloading a conflicting record replaces the local form, so compare your values first.

sections.title: Access and preferences
paragraphs: Navigation access and write permission are checked by the demo API. The demo administrator can write; other authorized users can read. Effective theme, font scales, density, table settings, number/date/time formatting and language are inherited, including tenant locks. Currency comes from the ledger; formatting does not convert amounts. The five-step workflow and care tabs are fixed by this template, rather than the generic record navigation preference.

sections.title: Integration
paragraphs: Compose RegistrationWorkspace with a RegistrationAdapter, ClinicalTemplateAdapter, authenticated scopeKey and PreferenceHost. The POST /op-registration endpoint loads configuration and executes versioned commands. Providers and services are read from CSV; encounters, appointments, payments and retry receipts share an atomic CSV snapshot scoped by tenant and application. Patient demographics reuse the existing patient API. These encounter records are separate from the older consultation and billing template stores. No real payer, payment, messaging or electronic-signature integration is connected.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: This library previews backend-generated barcode and QR labels. Use dedicated pages for items, specimens, patient bands, documents, payment demos, batch printing and printer profiles.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Choose a template, paper profile, records and copies. Generate a preview, verify the identifying information, then open Print preview. Use actual size and disable browser headers. Save as PDF through the browser print dialog. Printing records a request, not confirmed physical delivery.

sections.title: Validation and recovery
paragraphs: The API rejects invalid records, excessive copies and labels that do not fit the paper. Reprints require permission and a reason. Retry preserves the operation identity. Payment links are synthetic; only an administrator can simulate payment status, and expired requests cannot be printed.

Your default stock does not fit this label. A compatible profile is selected for this preview; your saved default is unchanged. The tenant-locked printer stock does not fit this label. Ask your administrator to unlock it or select compatible stock.

sections.title: Access and preferences
paragraphs: The server isolates jobs by tenant, application and user. Tenant administrators control copy limits, reprints and locked printer profiles. Users can save an unlocked default profile. Screen preferences and language apply to the interface; printed codes retain approved dimensions and black-on-white contrast.

sections.title: Integration
paragraphs: Inject LabelAdapter and effective preferences into LabelPrintingWorkspace. The authenticated POST /label-printing API owns record lookup, code generation and job history. Templates use JSON; synthetic records and scoped jobs use CSV. Replace the adapter for real applications. Payment providers, direct thermal printing and physical scanner certification remain external integrations.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a preference group and adjust an available setting. Changes save automatically. Managed settings are enforced by your tenant administrator. Imports and resets cannot override a lock.

Administrators with preference-management permission can open Preference policies, choose default values and lock settings. Save policy applies the policy to this tenant and application. Unlocking restores saved personal choices.

tour.text: Basic filters are always visible. Open Advanced filters for dates and less common fields.

tour.title: Choose a view
tour.text: Switch between a dense table and a card grid. Your choice is saved to your account.

tour.title: Pick your columns
tour.text: Show or hide columns per worklist. Click a header to sort. Saved per browser or per account, your choice.

tour.title: Create a record

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: Read page guides, published releases, patches and change notices for this application.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Choose a guide or a release. Search by title, module or guide content. Select a release to read the guide snapshot for that version. Open What’s new to find changes affecting pages you can access.

Read explanation opens the linked section and records the notice as read. I understand is a separate acknowledgment and appears only when required. Reference guides and unreviewed translations are clearly labeled.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Enter at least one search criterion, then select Search. Search anywhere matches whole words, quoted phrases and exclusions; the labelled fields support partial values. More filters includes ID type, nationality, residing country, gender, date of birth and status.

Choose table or cards and open patient details inline, in a dialog, or in a drawer. Previous and next navigate the current result page. Save a named preset to the API, or reuse recent searches kept only in this workspace session. Record, booking, encounter and 360 actions retain patient identity.
Pass a ClinicalTemplateAdapter to ClinicalPatientWorkspace. The demo adapter uses the authenticated clinical-templates endpoint; business data and form metadata come from the API.

sections.title: Billing corrections and shared clinical rail
paragraphs: Open Invoices & payments, then View bill for the full invoice, insurance, line totals, receipts and revision history. Edit bill changes quantities, discount, insurance authorization and notes on unpaid issued invoices. Enter a correction reason and confirm. The API recalculates using its current tariffs and retains the previous invoice snapshot. Payment history, including refunds, prevents edits. Conflicts require loading and reviewing the latest ledger before saving again. Unsaved correction values survive recoverable failures; Back to billing confirms discard.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: Select a patient, convert prescriptions, add service orders, review insurance and totals, issue an invoice, then record partial or full demo payments. Open receipts and history to review changes.

Use the public typed workspace and adapters shown in TypeScript. The authenticated demo API reads patient CSV and writes a separate billing CSV ledger. Replace adapters to connect another application.
Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.

Input remains on screen during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load the latest ledger after a conflict and review your retained input. Browser-close draft restoration is not provided.

Fictional single-process demo: no real card processing, insurance submission, tax certification, pharmacy dispensing or accounting posting. Refunds reverse a full payment; invoices cannot be edited after issue.
Billing money keeps at least two decimal places so cents are not lost; general quantities retain your number preference.

sections.title: Validation and recovery
paragraphs: The server rejects missing identity and consent, duplicate active visits, stale record versions, invalid vital signs and payments above the balance. Signed notes use addenda. Pending results require an owner, due date and plan before checkout. Network retries reuse the operation ID. Saved drafts require identity and consent review again; tenant storage, retention and field exclusions apply. Reloading a conflicting record replaces the local form, so compare your values first.

sections.title: Access and preferences

Currency comes from the ledger; formatting does not convert amounts. The five-step workflow and care tabs are fixed by this template, rather than the generic record navigation preference.

sections.title: Integration
paragraphs: Compose RegistrationWorkspace with a RegistrationAdapter, ClinicalTemplateAdapter, authenticated scopeKey and PreferenceHost. The POST /op-registration endpoint loads configuration and executes versioned commands. Providers and services are read from CSV; encounters, appointments, payments and retry receipts share an atomic CSV snapshot scoped by tenant and application. Patient demographics reuse the existing patient API. These encounter records are separate from the older consultation and billing template stores. No real payer, payment, messaging or electronic-signature integration is connected.
