changes.title: Tenant Admin: Overview
changes.summary: Review configuration readiness, resource totals, upcoming versions and recent activity.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Billing access grants
changes.summary: Per-identity, per-branch billing permissions. The latest grant for a person and branch is the one that counts.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Commercial authority
changes.summary: Explicit rights to read, author or publish commercial catalogue tables. Module access alone is not enough.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Document numbering
changes.summary: Number sequences consumed when invoices, receipts, credit notes and claims are issued.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Items and services
changes.summary: The billable service catalogue: kind, unit, category and tax classification.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Categories and terminology
changes.summary: Category tree, service groups and the terminology releases items are coded against.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Tax rules
changes.summary: Jurisdiction tax treatment per tax category. Missing treatment sends charges to review — never to zero tax.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Price books and prices
changes.summary: Tariff books with currency, precision and rounding, and the item rates inside each book.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Discounts
changes.summary: Governed discounts with scope, eligibility, combination and before- or after-tax timing.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Modifiers and MPR
changes.summary: Procedure modifiers and multiple-procedure reduction ranks used by FFS_MODIFIERS pricing.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Commercial releases
changes.summary: Immutable publication of commercial versions. Imported catalogues are not live until a release is approved.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Payers, TPAs and sponsors
changes.summary: Tenant financial identities for insurers, payers, TPAs and corporate sponsors.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Networks
changes.summary: Commercial networks referenced by plans, contracts and branch arrangements.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Plans and benefit rules
changes.summary: Risk bearer, administrator and network for each plan, with the benefit rules that split liability.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Contracts
changes.summary: Effective commercial terms binding a party, plan and network to a price book.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Branch arrangements
changes.summary: The exact insurer, TPA, plan, network and contract combinations each branch accepts.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Benefit pools
changes.summary: Explicit family or aggregate deductible, out-of-pocket and maximum-benefit pools.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Billing policy
changes.summary: The tenant default and permitted branch overrides. Billing stays closed without an approved, enabled tenant default.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Reimbursement routes
changes.summary: Mixed-model selection by item, category, contract and care setting. Priority wins first, then specificity.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Stay and case models
changes.summary: Per-diem day bands and case-rate packages priced from the actual accommodation ledger.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: DRG configuration
changes.summary: Licensed grouper binding, weight table and the local contract overlay. Not a national certified algorithm.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Category rates
changes.summary: Diagnosis-based classification rules and rates. Lower rule priority numbers win here.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: E&M level tables
changes.summary: Professional and facility level tables used by the dedicated E&M determination workflow.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Advanced models
changes.summary: Capitation, bundle, global budget, pay-for-performance and cost-plus contract settlements.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Exchange profiles and routes
changes.summary: Approved message profiles and payer routes. Endpoints and credentials stay deployment-owned.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Payment and refund providers
changes.summary: Collection and refund payout bindings. A simulator never moves real money.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Chart of accounts
changes.summary: Legal-entity accounts. Nothing is seeded automatically in production.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: GL mappings
changes.summary: Versioned role-to-account mappings. A missing mapping fails posting closed and is shown as an exception.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Fiscal periods
changes.summary: Open, soft-closed and closed accounting periods per legal entity.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Workflows and rules
changes.summary: Versioned checkpoint graphs for claims, appeals and collections. They add guards; they never remove financial checks.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Assistance and marketplace
changes.summary: AI assistance profiles and marketplace packages. Installation never grants authority.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Approvals inbox
changes.summary: Review submitted configuration changes requiring an independent decision.

changes.title: Tenant Admin: Activity log
changes.summary: Review append-only configuration actions, reasons and authenticated actors.

changes.title: MedBand Patient Access: Today
changes.summary: Review today’s encounters for the selected counter, then open patient access work without creating duplicate visits.

changes.title: MedBand Patient Access: Find patient
changes.summary: Find a patient by name, MRN, telephone, coverage member identifier or national identifier.

changes.title: MedBand Patient Access: Register patient
changes.summary: Register a patient with validated identity/contact details and optional insurer coverage.

changes.title: MedBand Patient Access: Patient record
changes.summary: Review the patient’s Episode → Case → Encounter hierarchy and admission requests.

changes.title: MedBand Patient Access: New encounter
changes.summary: Create a counter-authorized outpatient, follow-up, emergency, inpatient, day-care, diagnostic, teleconsult or home visit.

changes.title: MedBand Patient Access: Admissions
changes.summary: Manage admission clearance, actual admissions and the bed board.

changes.title: MedBand Patient Access: Request admission
changes.summary: Request admission linked to a patient, case and, where present, an originating encounter.

changes.title: MedBand Patient Access: Encounters
changes.summary: Review actual visits and their counter, patient, case, episode and workflow status.

changes.title: MedBand Patient Access: Episodes and cases
changes.summary: Review longer-running episodes and their individual clinical problem cases.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Billing home
changes.summary: Today across every queue.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Patient and encounter coverage
changes.summary: Verify each patient’s insurance before services are billed. Unverified coverage cannot be used for claims.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Payer authorizations
changes.summary: Request and track prior authorization. A partial approval records the approved amount for the claim.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Eligibility checks
changes.summary: Real-time eligibility against the payer. Results come from the simulator in this environment.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Estimates and admission clearance
changes.summary: Give patients a cost estimate and clear admission once the required deposit is held. Overrides need a second person.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Deposits
changes.summary: Money held against an encounter. Apply it to invoices, or request a transfer or refund for a second person to approve.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Cash drawer
changes.summary: Open and close cashier drawers. Variances beyond the tolerance go to a supervisor for review.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Unbilled worklist
changes.summary: Encounters with charges not yet invoiced. Mark ready, hold with a reason, or create the invoice draft from priced charges.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Charge detail
changes.summary: Every captured charge line. Price from the catalogue, reprice with a reason, send to review or reverse.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Manual charges and procedure groups
changes.summary: Fees that no clinical order produces. Each needs approval by a second person before it becomes a charge.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Invoices
changes.summary: Draft invoices are issued by someone other than the person who drafted them. Issued invoices never change; corrections use notes.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Debit notes
changes.summary: Increase what is owed on an issued invoice, for example a late charge. Issued by a second person.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Credit notes
changes.summary: Reduce what is owed on an issued invoice. Never more than the open balance; approved by a second person.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Adjustments
changes.summary: Contractual allowances, small-balance and bad-debt write-offs. Every write-off is decided by a second person.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Receipts and allocation
changes.summary: Record money received and allocate it to open invoices. Voids need a second person and only apply to unallocated receipts.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Refunds and payouts
changes.summary: Approve refunds, dispatch them to the payout provider and confirm the outcome. The simulator never moves real money.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Packages
changes.summary: Prepaid service packages. Record sessions as they are used; cancelling refunds the unused share less the fee.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Claims
changes.summary: Every payer claim from ready to paid. Submission through the exchange creates a tracked message.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Exchange monitor
changes.summary: Live view of messages to and from payers. Retry failures or resolve them manually with a reason.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Remittances
changes.summary: Payer remittance advice. Posting updates every claim and invoice it covers, so it is checked by a second person.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Remittance corrections
changes.summary: Correct a keying or payer error on a posted remittance line. The difference is applied to the invoice on approval.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Appeals
changes.summary: Contest denials before the filing deadline. Filing is approved by a second person; outcomes record what was recovered.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Payer reconciliation
changes.summary: Compare what each payer should have paid with what arrived, period by period. Sign-off is independent.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Responsibility transfers
changes.summary: Move a balance between payer levels or to the patient. Approval moves the money and bills the new party.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Aging
changes.summary: Open balances by age and party.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Payment plans
changes.summary: Instalment agreements for patient balances. Approval generates the schedule; payments reduce it in order.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Statements
changes.summary: Patient statements generated each cycle. Send them, record returned mail, or suppress for a reason.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Dunning and collections
changes.summary: Overdue patient balances move through reminders to a final notice. Agency referral needs a second person.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Reports
changes.summary: Revenue cycle performance.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Coding worklist
changes.summary: Assign diagnosis and procedure codes. Coding is validated by a second coder before billing uses it.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: CDI clarifications
changes.summary: Clinical documentation questions to clinicians. Answers return to the coder; unanswered queries escalate.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: DRG grouping
changes.summary: Run the licensed grouper on coded inpatient stays and validate the result before claims use it.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: E&M determinations
changes.summary: Determine the visit level from medical decision making or time. A second person confirms or overrides it.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Model settlements
changes.summary: Capitation, bundle, budget and performance settlements per contract period, posted to the ledger after approval.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Journals and exceptions
changes.summary: Balanced journals produced by billing events. Missing GL mappings stop posting and appear here as exceptions.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: GL reconciliation
changes.summary: Match subledger balances to the general ledger for each control account and period.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Exports
changes.summary: Batches of posted journals for the ERP. Each batch is approved before export and carries a checksum.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Approvals inbox
changes.summary: Everything waiting for a second person.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Workflow worklist
changes.summary: Checkpoint tasks from claim, appeal, coding and collection workflows. Pick one up, block it with a reason, or finish it.

changes.title: RCM Workspace: Assistance
changes.summary: Suggestions from operational assistance. They never change records; a person accepts or dismisses each one.

changes.title: MedSlot: Dashboard
changes.summary: Select MedSlot in the header and review How the hospital is running.

changes.title: MedSlot: Book appointment
changes.summary: Find an existing patient or use quick registration with consent.

changes.title: MedSlot: Calendar
changes.summary: Choose Day, Week or Month and the date range. Filter by department and resource type.

changes.title: MedSlot: Appointments
changes.summary: Filter by dates, status, service, department or patient.

changes.title: MedSlot: Patients
changes.summary: Search by name, MRN or phone; open a patient to see the detail workspace.

changes.title: MedSlot: Resources & schedules
changes.summary: Filter bookable doctors, staff, rooms, chairs, beds and equipment.

changes.title: MedSlot: Services
changes.summary: Review the service catalogue and its required resource types.

changes.title: MedSlot: Departments
changes.summary: Review departments and their specialties.

changes.title: MedSlot: Holidays
changes.summary: Filter holidays and closures by date or department.

changes.title: MedSlot: Notifications
changes.summary: Review templates by event, channel and scope; inspect variable previews before saving.

changes.title: MedSlot: Users & settings
changes.summary: Review the scheduling roster and booking rules.

changes.title: MedSlot: Audit log
changes.summary: Filter audit evidence by actor, entity and action.

changes.title: MedSlot: Patient details
changes.summary: Review patient identity, contact details and linked appointments.

changes.title: MedSlot: Resource details
changes.summary: Review resource identity, service links, slot length and capacity.
